title: Build reliable agents
description: Tool contracts, durable execution, retrieval, memory, evaluation, MCP and interoperability.
exercise: Build one incident-triage agent with two read-only tools. Replay 20 saved incidents; measure task success and recovery from tool timeouts.

title: Secure agent actions
description: Identity, delegation, prompt injection, tool policy, sandboxing and independent audit trails.
exercise: Add hostile tool output and a malicious retrieved document to the same test set. Verify that policy rejects unauthorized actions outside the model.

title: Observe and evaluate agents
description: Connect a user task to model calls, tool calls, outcomes, cost and policy decisions.
exercise: Trace one task across all tool calls. Add outcome checks, latency and cost budgets, and an alert for repeated failing tool calls.

title: Secure AI infrastructure
description: Workload identity, GPU isolation, supply chain, network policy, attestation and data-center management planes.
exercise: Threat-model the path from user request to GPU, storage and BMC. Test a denied egress request and document who can access each management plane.
